title: A trigger
description: A trigger as it was put, the trigger field of what PUT /v1/agents/{key}/triggers/{trigger} answers. A trigger on a clock has every, missed and jitter, and any other field is the source's that it watches, which one of them names; without one, it asks on every run. A webhook has webhook, its secret and how a request is verified, and asks as each request arrives.

every.description: A cron expression, or a duration such as 30m.

prompt.description: What the agent is asked each time.

overlap.description: What a firing does while a run is still going: skip it, or queue its prompt.

missed.description: What a trigger does about the firings it missed while down.

jitter.description: Up to this many seconds of delay, chosen at random each time.
